nodes.title: Understand need
nodes.detail: The caller is asking about a car that is with a Toyota service centre or the body shop, or about its last visit. Do not greet. This step only records what they need: do not look a…
nodes.comment: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 1. What does the caller need? This step only classifies; it answers nothing. Limit: two requests to rephrase, then a person (count from E20): the third turn that ends without a clear need leaves through ON_EXHAUSTED, and the step is told not to ask a third time. The step can be left three ways besides a clear need: safety_flag (safety agent), person_request (a person, rule from E27) and __return_to_parent__ (another topic). A reply to something that was arranged a moment ago is recorded as the need already_arranged, with its one sentence in spoken_line (check_reply_only). ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

nodes.title: Identity status ≠ third party?
nodes.comment: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 3. Before any car detail is read: who is calling, and which car. The lookup ladder. The status service answers to a booking number, or to a plate together with the mobile number on the booking; a plate alone is refused. So: a. a booking number the caller confirmed is used first (it wins over a plate); b. a known plate is tried with the number the caller is ringing from, then with the contact number of this call, without a question; c. when that shows nothing, the booking for the plate is looked up once: a booking that belongs to the identified caller gives its booking number (back to a); otherwise the caller is asked once for the mobile number on the booking (E92: "then plate and phone"), but only when the answer can change the outcome (check_mobile_question); d. nothing shows: the service centre of that booking is emailed (E103), or, when no booking was found either, a person takes over. A caller whose car is not known is asked in the order of E92: the booking number first, then the plate (ask_reference), then the phone (ask_booking_mobile). Every step that listens goes back through check_safety; the flags below record what has been tried, so the walk from the top never repeats a lookup or a question. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- THE AI AGENT NEVER reads out details before confirming who is calling. A caller who rings for the owner and has not passed the one-time code arrives as "third_party" and gets no status (the code itself is E10, identity agent).

nodes.title: Ask reference
nodes.detail: To find the car you need its booking number or its plate number, and neither is known yet. Tries used so far: {{reference_tries}} of 2. If the caller already said a booking number…
nodes.comment: E92: for a caller whose car is not known, which includes every caller whose number is not on file: the booking number first, then the plate. One try is one read-back that the caller confirms or rejects, and each try ends this step, so the tries are counted by count_reference_try and capped at exactly two by retry_reference (the plate rule, E55). MAX_ATTEMPTS is the hard stop inside one try, for a caller who gives nothing to read back: the question, the read-back and two turns of slack. plate_only (N13) and reference_missed (the booking number matched nothing) narrow the question to the plate.

nodes.title: Say spoken line
nodes.comment: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 7. Leaving. How the last lines are said. Whatever depends on the status or on a time is worded in the caller's language by a reasoning step, which writes it to spoken_line and says nothing; say_spoken_line then says it and close_turn says the closing line. Both are fixed steps, so the closing line always comes last. If a reasoning step should speak instead of writing, what it said stands and the closing line still follows. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
